name: meeting-scribe
description: Rowan AIO: the all-in-one work hub — meetings, org directory, projects, links, brand, and toolbox. Local-first.
author: Tyler Kells

scripts.predist: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const d of ['dist-installer/win-unpacked','dist-installer/win-unpacked.tmp'])fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});try{for(const f of fs.readdirSync('dist-installer'))if(/\.(exe|blockmap|7z)$/.test(f))fs.rmSync('dist-installer/'+f,{force:true})}catch{}"
scripts.dist: electron-vite build && node scripts/build-mcp.js && node scripts/package.js
scripts.dist:test: npm run predist && electron-vite build && node scripts/build-mcp.js && node scripts/package.js --test
